title: Mexican Casserole
description: A hearty, flavorful Mexican casserole made with original and roasted ingredients, perfect for a weeknight dinner.
instructions: Cook oven-baked beans according to package instructions.
In a separate pan, sauté roasted peppers and onions until softened.
Add Dutch-style salsa and stir to combine.
In a large casserole dish, create a layer of tortillas.
Top with a layer of beans, followed by a layer of the pepper and onion mixture.
Repeat the layers two more times, finishing with a layer of tortillas on top.
Bake in the preheated oven for 25-30 minutes, or until the casserole is hot and bubbly.
Remove from oven and top with toffee-crusted corn.
Return to oven and bake for an additional 5-10 minutes, or until the corn is lightly toasted.
